answer: Milling a seat costs POA, not promises. Each identity planks one timber across the canyon — a voting seat, one per key — burning 25 POA at claim. Each epoch a gale publishes a fresh nonce; the seated key pegs its timber by signing within 90 seconds. Lottery auditors replay one timber in seven per epoch. A missed, stale, or shared peg saws the timber loose: seat struck, key benched two epochs; re-entry burns another 25 POA. Fakes pay per head: N fakes × 25 POA = 25N POA burned. Limit: honest seats pay the same 25.
